args.body:
Dear Litware Ltd,

Thank you for your patience. We’ve processed a refund of **120 units** for the incorrect seat overcharge on your account (ticket C-6967). Your seat count has also been corrected to **60** in our systems.

The refund should reflect in your account within 24 hours. If you do not see it, reply to this email for verification.

Regards,
IT Operations Team
